title: New Moon Ritual Correspondences by Sign

sections.heading: Sign Correspondences
sections.body: Use these correspondences for New Moon ritual suggestions by sign.

items.label: Aries
items.body: Mars kamea, red/orange candles, bloodstone, garnet, basil, skull symbol, oil lantern, chalice of water, incense. Themes: courage, action, fresh starts.

items.label: Taurus
items.body: Venus kamea, green/white candles, rose quartz, copper, peridot, roses, chalice of water, incense. Themes: grounding, financial stability, pleasure.

items.label: Gemini
items.body: Mercury kamea, yellow/white candles, agate, clear quartz, caduceus imagery, feather, chalice of water. Themes: communication, writing, networking.

items.label: Cancer
items.body: Luna kamea, silver/white candles, lavender, chalice of water, incense. Themes: home, emotional healing, ancestral work.

items.label: Leo
items.body: Sun kamea, golden/yellow candles, garnet, bay leaves, salt, feather, chalice of water. Themes: self-confidence, leadership, joy.

items.label: Virgo
items.body: Mercury kamea, yellow/white candles, agate, clear quartz, feather, chalice of water. Themes: organization, health, service.

items.label: Libra
items.body: Venus kamea, pink/white candles, rose quartz, copper, peridot, roses, chalice of water, incense. Themes: relationships, balance, harmony.

items.label: Scorpio
items.body: Mars kamea, red candles, bloodstone, garnet, basil, skull symbol, oil lantern, chalice of water, incense. Themes: transformation, shadow work, passion.

items.label: Sagittarius
items.body: Jupiter kamea, yellow/white candles, citrine, turquoise, green jasper, chalice of water, incense. Themes: expansion, truth-seeking, travel.

items.label: Capricorn
items.body: Saturn kamea, black tourmaline, salt, elm, oil lantern, chalice of water. Themes: ambition, structure, legacy.

items.label: Aquarius
items.body: Saturn kamea, black tourmaline, salt, elm, oil lantern, feather, chalice of water. Themes: innovation, community, independence.

items.label: Pisces
items.body: Jupiter kamea, yellow/white candles, citrine, turquoise, green jasper, chalice of water, incense. Themes: dreams, intuition, compassion.
